notes: Improved: The booking page has a new, cleaner layout, with arrival, checkout, occupants and amount still to pay shown at the top.
Improved: Booking details are now plain rows grouped into sections, so they're easier to scan and match your chosen theme colors.
Improved: Rental agreement, guest form, house rules, minimum age and photo ID are now together in one Paperwork section.
Improved: Vehicles, boats and pets now show on one line each in the Stay section, with plates included.
New: You can mark a guest's photo ID as checked with one click on the booking page.
New: Guest forms have a new Notes field you can add, and whatever the guest writes goes into the booking's notes.
Improved: The form option for adding answers to a booking's notes is now called "Save to notes".
Improved: The message shown when a guest completes a form is simpler.
